title: Scalar extension is an exact triangulated functor
statement:
For the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], fix a prime
$\ell\neq p$, finite extensions $E,L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a
$\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra inclusion $E\hookrightarrow L$. Let $Y$ be any scheme.
The scalar-extension functor
$$
-\otimes_E L:D^b_c(Y,E)\longrightarrow D^b_c(Y,L)
$$
of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], obtained from the completed integral
scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] restricted by
[lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-constructible] and then rationalized, is an
exact triangulated functor: it preserves shifts and carries distinguished
triangles of $D^b_c(Y,E)$ to distinguished triangles of $D^b_c(Y,L)$.

proof.text: Use the normalized natural isomorphism sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison from ordinary derived tensor to the completed scalar functor, restricted to the intrinsic integral constructible objects. Ordinary finite free scalar extension is exact, so its Mathlib derived functor is triangulated. Transport its coherent integer shift through the comparison and the fully faithful target inclusion using Functor.CommShift.ofComp. Functor.isTriangulated_iff_comp_right proves the restricted completed integral functor T is triangulated.

Identify the raw tensor-Hom scalar localization with the existing Verdier rationalization using Rationalization.tensorHomEquiv. The tensor formula preserves identity and composition; the equivalences on every Hom and unchanged objects give an equivalence of categories. Its comparison with Q proves that the raw localization is a localization at Rationalization.W. This does not change any chosen rational shift or triangles.

The object and pure tensor specifications of sfRationalScalarExtension give a natural isomorphism Q_E followed by rational scalar extension with T followed by Q_L: on integral morphisms use the specification with scalar one. Apply Functor.commShiftOfLocalization to descend the shift of T followed by Q_L. Its compatibility theorem says that this comparison commutes with every shift, including the connecting arrow of a triangle.

Mathlib Localization.essSurj_mapArrow applies to Q_E at Rationalization.W, which has the calculus of fractions of its triangulated localization. Thus every arrow is isomorphic to an image arrow. Since Q_E and Q_E followed by rational scalar extension are triangulated (the latter by the shift-compatible comparison with T followed by Q_L), Functor.isTriangulated_of_precomp proves rational scalar extension is triangulated. This lemma completes an image arrow to an integral distinguished triangle and transports its image via the standard comparison of mapped triangles; equivalently rational distinguished triangles are the isomorphic integral images.
